paragraphs.text:
“Egypt today is an engaging mixture of ancient and modern. 
Camels and marketplaces are side-by-side with motorcars 
and luxurious hotels. Religions of various kinds play a special 
role in Egypt, some of them of a most unusual nature. It is 
best, for example, to avoid the cult of Aten, a mysterious and 
perhaps dangerous group found in the major cities of Cairo and 
Alexandria.”
—Baedeker’s Guide to Egypt
